name: Hou–Zhao Conjecture 4.10, Welch functions not third-order sum-free (proved)
target: arXiv:2609.31489 Conjecture 4.10: for n = 2m+1 >= 7, X^(2^m+3) on F_(2^n) is not 3rd-order sum-free
result: True: the count is (2^n + 1 - 3K)/4 with K a Kloosterman sum, positive by Weil's bound.

notes.formal: Lean checks the algebra and small cases; the trace lemmas are checked numerically for n <= 21
notes.human: not yet refereed (Finite Fields and Their Applications package ready)
